sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.7070 of 2023
Order:

This writ petition is filed aggrieved by the action of the respondents No.2 in not registering the case based on the complaint of the petitioners against the respondents No.3 to 9 for creating false documents and thereby getting electricity connection with malafide intention to grab the open plot of the petitioners admeasuring 480 sq. yards in Plot Nos.382 and 383 in Survey No.76 situated at Injapur Village, Vanasthalipuram Mandal, Ranga Reddy District.

2. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, based on the detailed instructions, submitted that the respondent No.9/ Macha Ramanaiah lodged a complaint with the Station House Officer,
Vanasthalipuram, against the respondents No.5 and 6 and others contending that his late father Macha Rajalingam during his lifetime acquired land admeasuring 720 sq. yards in Sy.No.76 (part)
bearing plot Nos.382 and 3834 at Injapur Village.
During his lifetime, he never executed any document in favour of third parties.

After death of his father, his brothers, namely, Macha Srinivas and Macha Buchaiah hatched a plan to grab the property and created a Gift Settlement Deed dated 29.10.2008 vide document bearing No.4692/2008 before SRO, Vanasthalipuram.
His brothers brought one lady, by name Macha Rajalingamma, impersonating as the wife of his father late Macha Rajalingam.
His brothers do not have absolute right over the property and they are also legal heirs in the family property.
His brothers gave false information and declaration to the Sub-Registrar stating that they alone are the legal heirs to the property and succeeded in their illegal attempts.

His brothers again gifted the property to one Smt. Macha Rukmini, who is none other than the wife of Macha Buchaiah vide document bearing No.4308/2011.
3.

It is further stated that the said Rukmini sold the property to one Gasikanti Venu, S/o. G.
Yadagiri, R/o. Karimnagar vide document No.2102/2013.
The said Gasiknati Venu executed an agreement of sale cum general power of attorney with possession in favour of one K. Ravi Kumar and Totla Madhusudhan on 27.05.2019 vide document No.7430/2019.

Subsequently, the said K.
Ravi Kumar and Totla Madhusudhan executed sale deed in favour of one Nandyala Mamatha for 240 sq. yards vide document bearing No.6389/2022 dated 15.06.2022.

Based on the complaint of the respondent No.9, Cr.No.903 of 2022 was registered for the offences under Sections 420, 406,
468, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
A1 and A2 were apprehended in the said crime and as per their confession, Sections 419, 467 and 120(b) IPC were added and Section 34 IPC was deleted from the case.
A1 and A2 were remanded to judicial custody and were produced before the VII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Hayathnagar.
Subsequently, they were enlarged on bail.

GD entry was made on the complaint of the petitioners on 20.02.2023.
5.

GOVERNMENT OF U.P.1.
